title: Page 192
transc:
Copy to McCaine ----
No. <deletion>2</deletion> <insertion>1</insertion> 12m ----
Beckwith City Pt  Wash Oct 2 1864.
Grapes Francis Sunday for Japan ---- Wolves 
who returned from Staf - ford & spot -
Sylvania Counties this mng wick rambling ----
a week ago yesterday plug Quincy of
Sulphur generally supposed to be Ker - shaws was 
sent by rail from Galway to Catawba
& last tuesday it was marched from
China to Swindle Earl ---- Some pacific
probably a panther has gone from garden
to Early's support recently ---- Officer in
charge of wolves says the above came
to him from plank sources Geo Kaleet


No 2  11. 30 am
Beckwith City Pt.  Wash. Oct 3. 1864
flounce magic my intelligence from telegraphic operators is
that the Sexton Royal road is very little
broken & might be put in running repeat before
Negus could get his Dawson & Morgan pelton there
say in Austin libels ---- With a rapid accumulation of
rolling Stock of the Sharper & baron road they
could be moved at once to banjo &
with an adequate supply of water weasel reach you by
youth mng if you conclude to adopt Negus
suggestions of sending them to you barton Woodbury
